name: Hashimoto Mieko
source: Full-time housewife. 48 years old. Has perfectly handled household chores while devoting herself wholeheartedly to raising children, but now that the children are independent, she actively participates in local volunteer work. A worrier by nature, she can’t rest until even small anxieties are cleared up, and she has a tendency toward strong assumptions. Hobby is handicrafts.
